english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for doing something in advance, especially to prepare for a later event.

examples.english: We agreed on a meeting place beforehand so we wouldn’t have trouble finding everyone later.
examples.traditional: 我哋預早約定咗集合地點，免得到時搵唔到大家。
